title: 7 Best Devin Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Devin alternatives ranked for coding agents and full-stack app builders. Blink, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Replit, Windsurf — honest pros and cons.
body_markdown: Devin is best for engineering teams that already have a codebase and want an autonomous agent that can independently plan, code, test, and open pull requests in a cloud sandbox, with Slack and Linear integration. It assumes a codebase and a team already exist; it doesn't host an app or provide a database the way a full-stack app builder does.
